waive.linter: Zero-dependency by design; ESLint would be the only dependency in the repo and node:test already catches what matters at this size.
waive.typecheck: Same reason. Revisit if src/ outgrows a few hundred lines per file.
waive.formatter: Same reason. House style is enforced in review, not by a tool.
waive.codeowners: Single-maintainer repo; a CODEOWNERS file would name one person and change nothing.
